claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh /demo context; install worker, edit demo state, go offline, reload, and assert UI plus saved demo edit

claim: Demo data stays separate and recipe files stay in this browser
where: demo banner, import area, README, privacy page
sandbox: seed the real storage key, edit and reset /demo, assert the real bytes never change, assert only demo: storage changes, then exit

claim: No accounts, trackers, recipe uploads, or CDN assets
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record requests and cookies and assert same-origin assets only with no account fields

claim: Imports Markdown and JSON recipe files up to 2 MB each, including common schema.org fields
sandbox: fresh /demo context; import Markdown and schema.org JSON fixtures and reject a 2,000,001-byte file

claim: The demo opens three sample recipes and a four-sheet print preview
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert all three named samples, three recipe rows, and four print sheets

claim: Selects and orders recipes, scales numeric ingredient amounts, and updates prep or cook times
sandbox: fresh /demo context; rescale servings, reorder a recipe, edit prep time, and assert print preview results

claim: Builds one timeline for all selected recipes from one serving time
sandbox: fresh /demo context; change serving time and assert calculated events for all sample recipes

claim: Prints a cover and timeline, followed by one recipe per sheet
sandbox: fresh /demo context in print media; assert one cover, three recipe sheets, and forced page breaks

claim: Preserves supplied credits and allergy notes in the editor and print view
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert the exact sample credit and supplied allergy note in editor and print output

claim: Downloads a JSON backup of recipes and cooking packet settings
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download and parse backup, then assert all recipes and packet fields

claim: The free version prints three recipes per cooking packet
where: first screen, Binder Plus section, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; import a fourth recipe and assert only three remain selected and printable

claim: Existing Binder Plus licenses are verified with Sociobot without sending recipes
sandbox: fresh real-mode context with an intercepted approved endpoint; capture a returned token, assert the exact request, valid unlock, local token, and stripped URL

claim: New Binder Plus purchases are unavailable until approved checkout is enabled
sandbox: fresh real-mode context; assert the availability notice and absence of any checkout link

claim: The service worker caches the shell, removes old Dinner Binder caches, and excludes Azure control files
sandbox: fresh context; install and update the worker, seed a legacy cache, assert versioned cache and cleanup, then inspect 404 and security-header configuration

claim: Development and production build support Node.js 20
sandbox: run unit tests and the production build under an npx-provided Node 20 runtime

claim: Privacy and Terms are built-in routes with route-specific titles and metadata
sandbox: direct-load legal routes, assert titles, h1s and canonicals; test focus, back navigation, and designed unknown-route page

claim: The production build creates dist/index.html and a service worker
sandbox: run the production build from the claim command and assert both documented output files

claim: The product includes its factory records and uses the MIT License
sandbox: assert every documented factory record exists and LICENSE contains the MIT License

claim: Dinner Binder copies supplied allergy notes but does not detect allergens or provide safety advice
sandbox: fresh /demo context; enter a note, assert verbatim print output, and assert the limitation remains visible
